parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) to view available region IDs.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description:
The list of IP addresses for the whitelist. Up to 1,000 IP addresses are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. The following formats are supported:

- 10.23.12.24 (IP address)

- 10.23.12.24/24 (A CIDR block, where `/24` indicates the prefix length. The prefix length must be an integer in the range `[1,32]`.)

parameters.name: UpdateDb
parameters.description: Specifies whether to modify the whitelist for database port 5432. The default value is true.

parameters.name: UpdateWeb
parameters.description: Specifies whether to modify the whitelist for HTTP port 80 and HTTPS port 443. The default value is true.
